back: The ability to influence, inspire and guide others to work willingly towards a shared goal.
Leader: direction, vision, influence, followers choose to follow. Manager: plans, organises, controls, formal authority.
Directors (vision and strategy), managers (departments), supervisors (teams), worker representatives (voice of employees).
Vision, communication, integrity, decisiveness, empathy, resilience, knowledge, willingness to delegate; which matter most depends on the situation.
A person who influences colleagues through respect or skill without a formal position; can support or resist change.
A person with authority from a position, such as a director, manager or supervisor.
Gives direction, builds commitment and helps the business cope with change.
Good leadership raises motivation, teamwork and quality and lowers absence and turnover, but market and resources also matter.
Number of employees leaving in the year / average number of employees x 100.
